I told Hollis in a thread reply in #central-team that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is for 382 seats.

That's the number Tobias posted in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing posted there since has changed it. Hollis is a member of that channel, so they could already see the post. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed to share it.
